data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1
data.value: Welcome to the world of Mu.;We have been waiting for a hero like you to arrive and put a stop to the chaos brought on to the Mu realm by Kundun.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2
data.value: Continue listening.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3
data.value: However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4
data.value: A tutorial?;I look forward to it!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5
data.value: Tutorials are for children. Turn down the offer.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6
data.value: It won't take up too much of your time. I'll simply explain basic controls and hunting techniques.;Are you sure you don't want our help?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_7
data.value: I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_8
data.value: How can I turn him down...?;Alright, let's give it a try!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_9
data.value: I'm glad we can help. We aren't difficult to find.;Simply look for and talk to the Shadow Phantom Soldier in any of the towns.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_10
data.value: I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_11
data.value: I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_12
data.value: ...This is Noria, the kingdom of Elves! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_13
data.value: ...This is Lorencia, the kingdom of Dark Wizards and Dark Knights! So this is where my adventure begins.;Excellent! My adventure begins!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_14
data.value: ...This is Elveland, the kingdom of Summoners! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_15
data.value: It's nice to meet you.;May I ask who you are?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_16
data.value: Alright! Let's get started with the tutorial.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_17
data.value: Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the queen of Noria.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_18
data.value: ...Shadow Phantom?;Guardians of the queen?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_19
data.value: What are the queen's guardians doing at a place like this?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20
data.value: The queen's orders are to help those warriors starting out on their journey so that they can at least defend themselves against the forces of Kundun.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_21
data.value: ...I'm moved that the queen has made such orders.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_22
data.value: How will you help, exactly?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_23
data.value: I will teach you basic hunting and controls through a simple tutorial.;It's not that difficult, and I'm sure you'll finish it in no time.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_24
data.value: Great! I'll finish this tutorial in no time!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_25
data.value: Excellent! Let's get started with the tutorial.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_26
data.value: Let's start with something simple.;Close your quest window and either press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_27
data.value: Did you launch the Character Stats window?;That window contains the character's name and level, the name of the current server, and character statuses.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_28
data.value: ...There's nothing to it. But I would like to learn more....

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_29
data.value: Can you explain in more detail?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_30
data.value: We have much to cover. Let's move on to the next step.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_31
data.value: I'll explain this in more detail. What else do you wish to know?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_32
data.value: ...I wish to learn about...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_33
data.value: EXP Points and Leveling Up

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_34
data.value: Character and Server Selection

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_35
data.value: Points and Status

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_36
data.value: Gain EXP points to level up.;You can find out how many more points you need to reach the next level by checking your Character Stats window or the EXP bar located at the bottom of your screen.;The bar is divided into ten segments, and filling them up will elevate you to the next level.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_37
data.value: ...Is that right? And then I'd like to learn about...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_38
data.value: Character and Server Selection

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_39
data.value: Points and Status

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_40
data.value: You've explained enough. Let's continue with the tutorial.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_41
data.value: The Character Stats window will tell you the name of your character, the name of the current server, and your character's class. It's possible to connect to different channels within a single server using the same character.;There are four basic character classes: the Elf, the Dark Knight, the Dark Wizard, and the Summoner. Reach level 220 with any of these basic characters to unlock the Magic Gladiator, and level 250 to unlock the Dark Lord.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_42
data.value: Leveling up will earn you points. These points can be used to enhance your strength, agility, stamina, and energy and thereby affect your damage, defense, HP, and MP levels, respectively.;Carefully use these points, for how you develop your character will determine its combat characteristics and the types of weapons and skills it can use.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_43
data.value: Now, press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_44
data.value: The Inventory window will display the items you have and the equipments you are wearing.;Click on an item to change its position or, if it's a consumable, right-click on it to use it. Did you get all that?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_45
data.value: Of course I did.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_46
data.value: Quick, on to the next step!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_47
data.value: You are full of zeal! Very well. Let's try adding an item to your inventory. Take the Zen I just gave you and purchase 5 apples from a merchant.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_48
data.value: Finally, a quest! You want me to buy 5 apples from a merchant?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_49
data.value: Excellent! I will be back in a flash.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_50
data.value: Where can I find a merchant?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_51
data.value: Apples can be purchased from potion merchants. In Lorencia, look for Potion Girl Amy, who is located across the bridge (128,85). In Elveland, look for Silvia, who is in the 1 o'clock direction from the center of the square (45,227). In Noria, look for Elf Lala, who is slightly to the north from the town's center (172,124).

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_52
data.value: ...Finding a merchant is more difficult than I thought.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_53
data.value: How do I check coordinates?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_54
data.value: The character's current coordinates are shown on the top left corner of the screen. Movement in the �� or �� direction changes the first number, and movement in the �� or �� direction the second.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_55
data.value: It's possible to find out the location of myself and others using coordinates? Amazing!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_56
data.value: Loud and clear! Give me the next quest!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_57
data.value: Go find the merchant in town and bring back 5 apples.;The NPC's name will be shown in light blue, and the point symbol will turn into a tooth symbol when you scroll over it with your mouse.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_58
data.value: Look at the right side of your screen. Do you see the apples you just bought? Adding a potion to the Inventory will automatically register it.;Press the Q button to use apples, potions, and other HP recovery items and the W button to use MP recovery items.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_59
data.value: Whoa! That's really convenient!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_60
data.value: Continue the conversation.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_61
data.value: Since you now have potions, would you like to leave the safe zone and do some real hunting? Are you ready?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_62
data.value: Great! I finally get the chance to show off what I can do.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_63
data.value: Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_64
data.value: Explain potions to me once more.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_65
data.value: Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 3 Chain Scorpions.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_66
data.value: Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 3 Budge Dragons.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_67
data.value: Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_68
data.value: I see you've successfully completed your first hunt! Did you find it difficult? Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.;You can pick up items dropped by defeated monsters using the mouse or automatically by pressing the space bar.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_69
data.value: Did you say the space bar?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_70
data.value: That will surely make things easier. Do you have any other tips?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_71
data.value: I already knew that. What's the next quest?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_72
data.value: Also, if you find yourself far away from a town or cornered while on a hunt, the Town Portal Scroll can come in really handy. Are you familiar with using it?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_73
data.value: ...Town Portal Scroll?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_74
data.value: What is this Town Portal Scroll?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_75
data.value: Of course I know. What's the next quest?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_76
data.value: Town Portal Scrolls can be purchased from potion merchants in towns. They are single-use items that will bring you back to the last town you visited.;Since we're on the subject, will you go and purchase a Town Portal Scroll from the merchant? It'll be easier to understand if you try it for yourself.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_77
data.value: ...Hmm. I didn't know such thing existed.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_78
data.value: Very well. How many do I need to buy?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_79
data.value: Go see the potion merchant again and buy just 1 Town Portal Scroll.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_80
data.value: You've done well. Let's see to one more thing before I ask you to face tougher monsters. Talk to me again and receive a damage and defense increase buff.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_81
data.value: A damage and defense increase buff? That sounds great!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_82
data.value: How do I get it?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_83
data.value: Close the Quest window and click on me again. After that, select 'Receive damage and defense increase buff.' This buff is available to anyone under level 220.;After receiving the buff, you will see an icon on the top left corner of the screen, a blue light effect surrounding the character, and have one hour of enhanced damage and defense.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_84
data.value: Excellent! It's time for the next quest. Since you are now familiar with hunting, let's get you to go after a tougher monster.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_85
data.value: Just say the word!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_86
data.value: Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_87
data.value: Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 30 Beetle Monsters. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_88
data.value: Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 30 Hounds. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_89
data.value: Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 30 Polluted Butterflies. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_90
data.value: I see you've now mastered hunting. When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_91
data.value: ...Skill attacks?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_92
data.value: Where can I learn skills?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_93
data.value: This is common knowledge.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_94
data.value: If you are an Agility Elf, whose priority is defense, you can equip a weapon and use its skills. If you are an Energy Elf, whose priority is wizardry, you can purchase orbs to learn skills.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_95
data.value: ...How do I do it?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_96
data.value: I want to be an Elf who focuses on defense!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_97
data.value: I want to be an Elf who focuses on wizardry!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_98
data.value: I don't want to decide right now. Just describe them for me.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_99
data.value: So you've decided to become an Agility Elf, a class for whom defense is crucial. Agility Elves are unique in that they employ splendid bow skills. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_100
data.value: So you've decided to become an Energy Elf, a class for whom wizardry is crucial. Energy Elves are unique in that they employ a variety of summoning and magic spells. Let me give you an orb as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_101
data.value: Dark Knights are unique in that they are powerful swordsmen who rely on both weapons and orbs. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_102
data.value: Dark Wizards are unique in that they are capable of mastering various magic spells from scrolls and parchments. Let me give you a scroll as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_104
data.value: The weapon I gave you is a crossbow. To equip it, load the crossbow item to the equipment slot in your Inventory. Go ahead and equip it.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_105
data.value: The orb I gave you will teach you the Summon Goblin skill. Right-click on the item to learn the skill. Go ahead and learn the skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_106
data.value: The weapon I gave you is a Double Axe. To equip it, load the Double Axe item to the equipment slot in your Inventory. Go ahead and equip it.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_107
data.value: The scroll I gave you will teach you the Fire Ball skill. Right-click on the item to learn the skill. Go ahead and learn the skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_108
data.value: If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_109
data.value: After learning a skill from an orb, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_110
data.value: After learning a skill from a scroll, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_111
data.value: ...The icon next to the number 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 slots....

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_112
data.value: I got it!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_113
data.value: You've done well. The Triple Shot skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Triple Shot? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_114
data.value: You've done well. The Summon Goblin skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Summon Goblin? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_115
data.value: You've done well. The Falling Slash skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Falling Slash? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_116
data.value: You've done well. The Fire Ball skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Fire Ball? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_117
data.value: I learned a skill!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_118
data.value: Where can I learn more skills?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_119
data.value: Elves can learn additional skills by going to Noria and purchasing orbs from Elf Lala (173,124) or weapons from Eo the Craftsman (195,123).

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_120
data.value: Dark Knights can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing orbs from Pasi the Mage (119,112). After purchasing an orb, right-click on it to learn the skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_121
data.value: Dark Wizards can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing scrolls from Pasi the Mage (119,112) or weapons from Hanzo the Blacksmith (116,142).

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_122
data.value: Summoners can learn additional skills by going to Elveland and purchasing scrolls from Marce (36,218). After purchasing a scroll, right-click on it to learn the skill.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_123
data.value: ...I see it pays to know a lot of NPCs.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_124
data.value: I understand well. What's the next quest?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_125
data.value: We're nearing the end of our tutorial. Now that you have a skill, it'll make sense for you to build more combat experience. Come back when you reach a certain level, and I will give you a Uniria as a reward.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_126
data.value: ...Uniria?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_127
data.value: What's a Uniria?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_128
data.value: What level do I need to be?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_129
data.value: Uniria is a mount item you can use out in the battle field. Equip it to the top left corner of your Inventory window for faster travel throughout the battle field.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_130
data.value: ...That's fantastic!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_131
data.value: What level do I need to be?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_132
data.value: Come back once you've reached level 25.;I will then reward you with a Uniria as a gift.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_133
data.value: You've truly become a fine warrior. I'm sure the queen herself will be proud of you. Truth be told, she has arranged a few items for warriors such as you.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_134
data.value: ...The queen is very thoughtful!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_135
data.value: Continue listening.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_136
data.value: I will give you the queen's gifts if you pass a test to see if there's anything else you need to know and if you have the basic knowledge to travel throughout the MU realm. How about it?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_137
data.value: Hmm...a test...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_138
data.value: Excellent! Bring on the test!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_139
data.value: I'd rather you give me the gifts without the test.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_140
data.value: The test is simple enough, and it won't matter if you don't get everything right. If you do, however, there's a small bonus gift.;Are you sure you don't want to take the test?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_141
data.value: ...A bonus gift if I answer all the questions right?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_142
data.value: Excellent! Bring on the test!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_143
data.value: I'll just take the queen's gifts without taking the test.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_144
data.value: Here's your first question.;How do you trade with a character that's in front of you?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_145
data.value: ...trade...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_146
data.value: Press D and select Trade or type in '/trade' in the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_147
data.value: Press D and select Trade or type in '/exchange' in the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_148
data.value: Press D and select Trade or type in '/invite' in the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_149
data.value: That is correct! Pressing D will give you access to various commands, including Trade, Party, Buy, and Follow. Use these commands well.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_150
data.value: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. To trade, press D and select Trade or face the character and type in '/trade' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_151
data.value: When you want to form a party with a character, face that character and enter '/party' in the Chat window. What do you do if you don't want to receive party requests?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_152
data.value: Party request?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_153
data.value: Type in '/off' in the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_154
data.value: Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_155
data.value: Type in '/Party off' in the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_156
data.value: That is correct! If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in '/Request off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_157
data.value: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window to turn down party requests. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_158
data.value: Whispers are used to talk to friends who are far away or to pass on private messages. Which button is used to send whispers from the Chat window?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_159
data.value: ...Whispers...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_160
data.value: From the Chat window, use the Shift button.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_161
data.value: From the Chat window, use the Ctrl button.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_162
data.value: From the Chat window, use the Tab button.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_163
data.value: That is correct! When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_164
data.value: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_165
data.value: You'll need to regularly repair your equipments since their durability will diminish as you hunt monsters. When you reach a certain level, you will be able to repair your equipments directly from the Inventory window. What level is that?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_166
data.value: Too easy! To repair equipment without the help of an NPC, I need to be at...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_167
data.value: Level 30

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_168
data.value: Level 50

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_169
data.value: Level 75

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_170
data.value: That is correct! You can have your equipment repaired by Hanzo the Blacksmith (117,140) in Lorencia, Rhea (30, 235) in Elveland, or Eo the Craftsman (194, 123) in Noria. Solicit their services often.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_171
data.value: Ah, you've answered incorrectly.; You'll be able to repair your equipment with ease by using the Repair button from the Inventory window once you reach level 50. However, this is more costly than repairing through an NPC.;Let's move on to the next question.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_172
data.value: The higher the level, the more distance you get to travel. Using the M button, however, it's possible to travel to distant areas in a flash. What is the minimum level you need to be and the amount of Zen you need in order to enter the Dungeon?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_173
data.value: Hmm...First, press M and then...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_174
data.value: Level 10 and 2,000 Zens

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_175
data.value: Level 30 and 3000 Zens

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_176
data.value: Level 50 and 4000 Zens

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_177
data.value: That is correct! In the MU world, you can use the M button to travel with ease, provided that your level is high enough and you have enough money for the destination.;Discovering areas that's right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_178
data.value: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Use M to find out and travel to accessible areas with ease. Discovering areas that are right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.;On to the next question.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_179
data.value: In MU, it's possible to combine different items to create new ones. In fact, trying out different combinations of items adds a whole new dimension to MU.;Whom should you seek out in order to combine items?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_180
data.value: The answer is obvious!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_181
data.value: The Goblin NPC in Noria.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_182
data.value: The Seed Master NPC in Elveland.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_183
data.value: The Trainer NPC in Lorencia.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_184
data.value: That is correct! With the help of NPCs in the towns, you can not only combine items, but also enhance your armor by adding jewels to it and much more. Make sure to visit them all.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_185
data.value: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Take the items, ingredients, and the money you need for combining to the Goblin in Noria to create a new item. Make sure to try it at least once. Let's skip to the next question.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_186
data.value: Congratulations. You've completed the tutorial. Take this Ring of Hero and this Ring of Warrior. They are gifts to you from the queen.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_187
data.value: ...Finally, the tutorial's finished!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_188
data.value: Ring of Hero? Ring of Warrior? What are they?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_189
data.value: Thank you!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_190
data.value: Ah, I'll have to go far back in time to explain that.;Runedil, the former queen of Elves, was saddened by the loss of all the new warriors of the MU empire, who gave up their lives to constant warring.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_192
data.value: Continue listening.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_193
data.value: So she imbued rings with the power of the Elves and gave them to warriors in honor of Muren's practice of handing out warriors' rings bearing the emperor's crest.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_195
data.value: Continue listening.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_196
data.value: That custom all but disappeared when peace finally came. However, Kundun and the chaos he brought motivated Erin Gustiv, the reigning queen of the Elves, to reinstate it.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_197
data.value: Ah. So that's what happened....

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_198
data.value: Continue listening.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_199
data.value: When a warrior who possesses them becomes a consummate expert in his or her art, these rings transform into unique items that will help their master attain greater heights.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_200
data.value: Oh! That will surely come in handy!

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_201
data.value: Take the rings.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_202
data.value: You'll be able to use the Ring of Hero at level 40 and the Ring of Warrior at level 80. Dropping the rings will break their seal and transform them into items.;Next time we meet, I sincerely hope to see a mightier warrior before me. data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1006
data.value: Gens Duprian is a guild of the greatest heroes in Arca and at its heart is the Duprian clan, the mightiest noble bloodline in MU. We are led by Duprian Winston, a knight who knows no equal in the whole of the MU empire.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1007
data.value: Go back.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1008
data.value: Gens dispute��? Gens Vanert��s rebellion is more like it. The gens dispute started because of the greed of Vanert Reicht, the commanding knight of Gens Vanert. Exactly five years ago, a band of heroes who were searching in La Cleon for a stone with the power to seal away Kundun were slaughtered. At the time, we believed it was the work of Selupan, a giant spider and the ruler of La Cleon, but soon learned that it was actually Gens Vanert. It is the duty of our proud Gens Duprian champions to retaliate and fight.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1009
data.value: Oh! You wish to become a member of Gens Duprian? Share our virtues of honor and respect, and help in the fight to crush the greed of Gens Vanert and find the stone that will seal away Kundun.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1056
data.value: Gens Vanert is a noble family led by Vanert Reicht, the greatest socialite in the whole of the MU empire. The master strives around the clock to put a stop to Duprian Winston and his dream of absolute rule over the empire.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1057
data.value: Vanert Reicht may have conceded leadership of Noble Alliance Arca to Duprian Winston at the alliance's inception, but the master has always remained committed to eliminating the foul minions of Kundun and to the revival of the MU empire. Everyone knows about Duprian Winston's desires to subjugate the empire under his absolute rule. It's imperative that heroes like you help Vanert Reicht seal away Kundun and restore peace to the MU empire.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1058
data.value: Hmm... you are a wise warrior. Go now and achieve great things in the name Gens Vanert, knowing that I will always be here to assist you.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1059
data.value: Congratulations on becoming a member of Gens Vanert. Much will be asked of you in the name of our cause. Come see me whenever you require assistance concerning the gens.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1060
data.value: You cannot join a gens if you are a member of the guild alliance. Leave the guild alliance and try joining the gens again.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1061
data.value: Congratulations. You have contributed more to the cause of the gens than any other member. Duprian Winston rewards your accomplishments. I hope to see even greater achievements from you next month.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_1062
data.value: Oh! Thanks to your bravery, we were able to crush those good-for-nothing Duprians once again. This is a reward bestowed to you by Vanert Reicht himself for your contributions in battle. I hope to see you in action once again next month.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2001
data.value: Would you like to visit Chaos Castle, the arena of the gods? There is no better place to prove your strength. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 15-49, Advanced character: Level 15-29)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2002
data.value: Chaos Castle...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2003
data.value: Very well. Tell me more.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2004
data.value: I know it well. I hear you need an item to participate in the event....

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2005
data.value: You're well-informed. I will give you the item you need to access Chaos Castle. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2006
data.value: A wise decision. Chaos Castle is a battle field created by Lugard, the god of the heaven world, and Secrarium, the god of the underworld, for the balance of good and evil in this world. However, travelers started going to Chaos Castle and fighting on the side of Lugard, tipping the balance in disfavor of Secrarium.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2008
data.value: To restore balance to the battle event, Secrarium made Lugard an offer and suggested implementation of a new rule. This rule was for everyone participating in the event to wear guardsman's armor. Lugard, believing the offer to be fair, accepted.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2009
data.value: I see.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2010
data.value: Unfortunately, Secrarium was betting that darkness in the hearts of the travelers would ultimately lead to hostility and discord among them. Lugard was also aware of the travelers' dark side, but his trust in them didn't waver. Ultimately, the travelers did begin to feud with one another like the dark god had anticipated, and Chaos Castle became ever more... chaotic.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2011
data.value: I guess Lugard was tricked by Secrarium. How do I participate?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2012
data.value: It's very easy to enter Chaos Castle. Simply right-click on your Armor of Guardsman at the appropriate times (12:00am, 14:00pm, 16:00pm, 18:00pm, 20:00pm, and 22:00pm) to enter. Players in designated locations, such as a PC cafe, will have more opportunities to enter.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2013
data.value: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2014
data.value: You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. The event starts once this standby time passes. Once it does start, travelers and corrupt guardsmen will fight each other to the death in a no-holds-barred melee.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2015
data.value: Is there anything I need to be cautious of?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2016
data.value: It doesn't matter with the travelers, but you have to be careful when you kill a corrupt guardsman. Corrupt guardsmen will explode and may even push you off the arena. If this happens, you will be disqualified.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2017
data.value: It all makes sense now.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2018
data.value: If you want to find out when you can enter, simply move your mouse over the Armor of Guardsman. If you want to enter, simply right-click on the armor at a designated time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter the event.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2019
data.value: You are back sooner than I thought. I will give you a quest that will earn you the item you need to enter the event. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 15-49, Advanced character: Level 15-29)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2020
data.value: By a 'simple quest', do you mean killing monsters?

data.value: Very well. It appears Larvae are causing quite a headache for novice travelers to the Dungeon these days. If you defeat 40 Larvae, I will offer you a choice of two rewards from 30 Healing Potions, 30 Mana Potions, and 4 Small SD Potions. When you claim you rewards, make sure you have at least 20 empty slots in your Inventory. Remember that.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2048
data.value: It's very easy to enter Chaos Castle. Simply right-click on your Armor of Guardsman at the appropriate times (12:00am, 14:00pm, 16:00pm, 18:00pm, 20:00pm, and 22:00pm) to enter. Players in designated locations, such as a PC cafe, will have more opportunities to enter.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2049
data.value: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2050
data.value: You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. The event starts once this standby time passes. Once it does start, travelers are pitted against 50 corrupt guardsmen in a no-holds-barred melee to the death.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2051
data.value: Is there anything I need to be cautious of?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2052
data.value: It doesn't matter with the travelers, but you have to be careful when you kill a corrupt guardsman. Corrupt guardsmen will explode and may even push you off the arena. If this happens, you will be disqualified.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2053
data.value: It all makes sense now.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_2054
data.value: If you want to find out when you can enter, simply move your mouse over the Armor of Guardsman. If you want to enter, simply right-click on the armor at a designated time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter the event.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3005
data.value: You're well-informed. In order to penetrate the barrier surrounding Blood Castle, you will need an Invisibility Cloak. If you pass a simple test of mine, I will provide you with an Invisibility Cloak before you head to Blood Castle. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3006
data.value: I will tell you then. Devildom's royal guards, who were summoned when Kundun succumbed to Secrarium, posed a great threat to the heaven world. To protect their base, the Twelve Saints formed a barrier around Blood Castle.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3008
data.value: Kundun, however, must've anticipated such a move. He hid beyond the range of the barrier and eliminated the Twelve Saints as soon as the barrier was formed. Luckily, Archangel evaded that peril and sacrificed himself for the barrier.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3010
data.value: Kundun's Royal Guards, however, continue to attack the barrier, and are weakening it. We need Archangel's weapon in order to prevent this weakening of the barrier, and that's why we are now seeking the help of travelers.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3011
data.value: I see. How do I enter?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3012
data.value: It's very easy to enter Blood Castle. The battle event takes place every two hours from 12:30am and on. To enter, take an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level to the Messenger of Archangel in Devias, five minutes before a Blood Castle event commences and ask to join. The Messenger of Archangel will then send you to the castle.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3013
data.value: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3014
data.value: You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. You'll enter Blood Castle after this standby time has elapsed. Once inside Blood Castle, you can buy some time by defeating 40 monsters summoned by a necromancer named Red Skull.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3016
data.value: Go past the castle gate and defeat two Red Skulls who have hidden the Absolute Weapon. This will buy you some more time and reveal a casket containing the weapon. Destroy the casket, defeat more monsters, and return the Absolute Weapon to Archangel to successfully complete the Blood Castle quest.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3017
data.value: I understand.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_3018
data.value: To find out when you can enter, simply press the F1 key. If you want to enter, take an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level to the Messenger of Archangel before the scheduled start time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the Invisibility Cloak so that you can enter Blood Castle.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4001
data.value: Are you familiar with a hidden training ground known as Devil Square? It's an opportune place to develop your skills. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 15-130, Advanced character: Level 10-110)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4002
data.value: Devil Square...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4003
data.value: Very well. Tell me more.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4004
data.value: I already knew that.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4005
data.value: You're well-informed. I'll give you the item you'll need to enter Devil Square. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4006
data.value: Devil Square is the place where the Elf Tree once stood. The Elf Tree was created by the mother of all Elves, an underground Elf known as Aria. This tree had the ability to produce Elves regularly. Then Secrarium tricked Lugard and appeared in Noria, at the location of the Elf Tree.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4008
data.value: Having set his eyes on the tree's power of birth, Secrarium corrupted the Elf Tree and transformed it into an Immoral Tree that gave birth to monsters. The monsters horde grew to astronomical proportions, and the kingdoms of the MU continent combined their forces to entrap the immoral tree in a space of nothingness.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4010
data.value: Monsters, however, continued to spawn at regular intervals from the spot where the tree once stood. After careful consideration, the queen of the Elves decided to make a training arena of this place for travelers.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4011
data.value: I see. How do I enter?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4012
data.value: It's very easy to enter Devil Square. It can be entered every four hours from 3:00 a.m. and on (3:00 a.m., 7:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m., 3:00 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 11:00 p.m.). To enter, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before a scheduled entry time and ask to join. Charon will then send you to Devil Square.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4013
data.value: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4014
data.value: You'll stand by for about a minute before actually entering. Once this standby time passes, monsters will start to appear. The monsters will continue to attack for ten minutes, and killing them will earn you points. If you score high enough, you might even receive a reward.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4015
data.value: Is there anything I should know about Devil Square?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4016
data.value: You'll face a steady stream of powerful monsters at Devil Square. Forming a party with other travelers before entering will give you a better chance of survival.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4017
data.value: It all makes sense now.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4018
data.value: To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll be sent to Devil Square. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item you need to enter Devil Square.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4019
data.value: You are back sooner than I thought. I have a simple quest that will earn you an invitation granting you access to Devil Square. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 15-130, Advanced character: Level 10-110)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4020
data.value: By a 'simple quest', do you mean killing monsters?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4021
data.value: Very well. Give me the quest.

data.value: I don't have the time right now. I'll do it next time.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_4023
data.value: That's unfortunate. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5001
data.value: Have you ever heard of Illusion Temple and the ancient relics hidden there? It's a place where travelers can find both wealth and fame. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (All characters: Level 220-270)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5002
data.value: Illusion Temple...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5003
data.value: Very well. Tell me more.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5004
data.value: I already knew that.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5005
data.value: You're well-informed. I'm in charge of distributing items that are necessary to enter Illusion Temple. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest that will earn you a ticket in.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5006
data.value: Illusion Spells, the foundation of Illusion Sorcery, was discovered by an Archaeologist named Mirage. Mirage found the spells' power to be too dangerous and sealed it. His partner Lev, however, stole the spells to brainwash people and establish Illusion Sorcery. Illusion Sorcery gradually grew larger and brought chaos to the continent.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5008
data.value: Grand Wizard Etramu vowed to destroy Illusion Sorcery and formed an army to subjugate its followers. Under Etramu's command, the alliance engaged the followers of Illusion Sorcery with formidable force. Despite having been driven all the way back to Illusion Temple, the followers continued to resist. As battle raged on, Lev disappeared and left the followers of Illusion Sorcery in confusion. Ultimately, they all met their death at the hands of the alliance on the temple grounds.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5010
data.value: Due to Lev's illusion spells, however, the souls of the dead followers remained in this world to defend the temple. These souls believed Lev's return would allow them to reclaim their bodies and continued to safeguard the temple. Today, the temple is guarded by the alliance in case Lev does actually return and Illusion Sorcery uses ancient relics to lure in unsuspecting travelers to their cause.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5011
data.value: I see. How do I enter?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5012
data.value: It's very easy to enter Illusion Temple. It can be entered every four hours from 01:00 a.m. and on: 01:00 a.m., 05:00 a.m., 09:00 a.m., 01:00 p.m., 05:00 p.m., and 09:00 p.m. To enter, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before an Illusion Temple event commences and ask to join. Mirage will then send you to the temple.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5013
data.value: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5014
data.value: Upon entering, you'll need to wait for other players to enter. The players will then be divided into two teams: Alliance Camp and Illusion Sorcery Camp. The camp that brings over more relics to their own side wins.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5015
data.value: Is there anything I should be aware of about Illusion Temple?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5016
data.value: You'll not be able to use certain skills like Teleport or Telekinesis while holding on to a relic. On the other hand, there are special skills that can only be used in Illusion Temple. Using these skills to your advantage will make it easier for your camp to win.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5017
data.value: It all makes sense now.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5018
data.value: To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll then be sent to Illusion Temple. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter Illusion Temple.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5019
data.value: You are back sooner than I thought. I have a simple quest that will earn you a Scroll of Blood, which will grant you access to Illusion Temple. Will you accept? (All characters: Level 220-270)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5045
data.value: Is there anything I should be aware of about Illusion Temple?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5046
data.value: You'll not be able to use certain skills like Teleport or Telekinesis while holding on to a relic. On the other hand, there are special skills that can only be used in Illusion Temple. Using these skills to your advantage will make it easier for your camp to win.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5047
data.value: It all makes sense now.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_5048
data.value: To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll then be sent to Illusion Temple. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter Illusion Temple.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6001
data.value: There are a number of ways you can prove your worth on the continent of MU. You can try to be the last one standing in Chaos Castle, or work with your comrades to battle through Blood Castle, Devil Square, or Illusion Temple. Travelers regard such feats as some of the worthiest accomplishments one can achieve.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6002
data.value: So it's not just about equipment or level.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6003
data.value: That's right. You do need good equipment and a high level to test your mettle against other travelers, yes. But just that isn't enough for you to become a hero of MU. I will help you receive recognition as a hero by giving you a series of missions. You may repeat these missions as often as desired.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6004
data.value: Recognition as a hero...

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6005
data.value: To start off, I'll give you a simple mission to see if you have the right qualities to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 240 - 270, Advanced character: Level 220 - 260)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6007
data.value: Sure! What's this simple mission about? (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6008
data.value: I don't need to be judged like this! (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6009
data.value: I'm sorry to hear that. There are many ways to become stronger, but they'll all take time. Remember that well.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6010
data.value: You have accepted the first trial. I want you to prove your combat prowess by defeating 5 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving till the end in Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Soul, or a Jewel of Chaos.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6011
data.value: Congratulations. You have completed the first mission. Then I will give you the second mission right away. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 240 - 270, Advanced character: Level 220 - 260)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6013
data.value: I accept the mission. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6014
data.value: No, I need some rest first. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6015
data.value: I'm sorry to hear that. You can't repeat the first mission if you abandon the second mission. You must complete the second mission before you can repeat the first mission. Please return if you change your mind.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6016
data.value: Good decision. This mission requires you to raise your worth by claiming victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 800,000 Exp.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6017
data.value: You have completed the first trial to become a hero. The next mission I'll give you is to see if you have the courage to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 300 - 320, Advanced character: Level 271 - 320)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6019
data.value: I accept the mission. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6020
data.value: I think I have enough courage already. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6021
data.value: Courage is the most important trait for a hero. If you lack the proper courage, you can never be reborn as a hero.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6022
data.value: Good decision. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Soul, a Jewel of Chaos, or a Jewel of Harmony.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6801
data.value: To grow quickly and become a powerful warrior, you must complete various event maps. Find a Phantom Soldier if you want to undertake an event map quest.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_6802
data.value: Defeat 5 monsters in Chaos Castle, deliver a weapon to Archangel in Blood Castle, and survive until the end of Devil Square. Complete all three and return to the Phantom Soldier to receive your reward.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20001
data.value: Welcome to the newly founded Devias branch of the mercenary guild. We're the one who stopped Kundun's Army along with the 5 major clans but now most of the veterans have retired. So we decided to adopt the Free Mercenary system as we open this guild office.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20002
data.value: What is the free mercenary?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20003
data.value: Free mercenary doesn't really belong to the mercenary guild; anybody can receive a request and get the reward only if he or she has certain sum of money for registration. We take the deposit for each request, but it's fully refundable as you finish the request. Don't you worry. We request you what you can handle.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20004
data.value: How much is the registration fee and the deposit?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20005
data.value: 1 million Zen for free mercenary registration and 500,000 Zen for deposit. Will you register as a free mercenary now? (Lv. 350 - Master Level)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20006
data.value: Hmm, free mercenary����

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20007
data.value: I will sign up. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20008
data.value: No, I don't want to. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20009
data.value: That's unfortunate, the reward is quite awesome. Please come back if you change your mind. (Free mercenary registration has been cancelled.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20010
data.value: A wise decision. Give me 1 million Zen and I will sign you up right away.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20011
data.value: Put 500,000 Zen as deposit and I will offer you a Letter of Request came to the mercenary guild. Each request has its level and difficulty. Right click on the Letter of Request to check the information. Please note that you need to press (T) and click 'Start Quest' button at the bottom to check the information again once you close the information window. Do you want to take a Letter of Request? (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20012
data.value: Hmm, Letter of Request����

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20013
data.value: Ok, I'll give it a try. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20014
data.value: I don't have time right now. I'll come back later. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20015
data.value: That's unfortunate, please come back later when you have time. (Failed to receive the Letter of Request.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20016
data.value: Here is the Letter of Request for you. Right click on the letter to check the information. Please note that you cannot receive refund of 500,000 Zen deposit if you give up the quest. You also need to bring the 'Request Completion Certificate' to get the refund. Once again, you need to press (T) and click 'Start Quest' button at the bottom to check the information again once you close the information window. Good bye, then.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20017
data.value: Mercenary's request varies depending on the day of the week. Please check the location and task before you start. (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20018
data.value: Oh, there are different requests depending on the day of the week.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20019
data.value: Check the request information. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20020
data.value: Request from Kalima; Location: Kalima 6; Task: Talk to Priestess Beina in the Underwater Temple; Reward: Random, Red Box; Note: Drop Lost Map +6 on the ground to enter Kalima

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20021
data.value: Hi, I'm Priestess Beina, protector of this Underwater Temple. This temple is Kundun's first target since Etramu keeps his body in the sealed stone. We're always short of fighters so I request help to the mercenary guild. Would you check the request? (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20022
data.value: The objective should be defending this place, then.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20023
data.value: Yes, please. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20024
data.value: I'm not ready yet. Please wait. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20025
data.value: I'll give you a full briefing when you're ready, then. May the grace of God be with you�� (The quest has been cancelled)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20026
data.value: First you need to eliminate Kundun's combatants who attack the temple entrance and then get rid of the enemies who cast spell on the sealed stone. I'll give you the 2nd goal when you finish 1st goal and come back to me. Here's the 1st goal; go to Kalima 6 and eliminate 30 Aegis and 20 Rogue Centurions, Kundun's combatants. (Party Possible)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20027
data.value: Good job. You made it easier for us to protect the temple entrance. The 2nd goal is to punish the enemies attacking the sealed stone. Etramu saved the empire by changing his body into a sealed stone, but his soul is getting engulfed with madness. Do you want to proceed? (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20028
data.value: It's easier than anticipated.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20029
data.value: Yes, right away. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20030
data.value: I'm not ready yet. Please wait. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20031
data.value: I'll give you a full briefing when you're ready, then. May the grace of God be with you�� (The quest has been cancelled.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20032
data.value: The last ones to deal with are Bloody Soldiers and Death Angels casting spell on the sealed stone. Kill 30 Bloody Soldiers and 20 Death Angels and come back to me to get reward. (Party Possible)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20033
data.value: Request from Merchant Zyro; Location: in every town; Task: Talk to General Goods Merchant Zyro; Reward: Random, Green Box; Note: General Goods Merchant Zyro goes round Noria, Elveland, Lorencia and Devias and sell things.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20034
data.value: What can I help you? Ah�� you're the one from the mercenary guild! Speaking frankly, I would never have requested the mercenary guild if I had had any other option�� Well, never mind. There are 2 requests, first is to collect the Stardust powder and secondly, obtaining a rare jewel. Will you accept? (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20035
data.value: ���� He seems to be a miser����

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20036
data.value: Yes, I'll take it. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20037
data.value: I don't feel like doing it. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20038
data.value: Better grab a chance than to regret it. Well, come back later if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20039
data.value: First task is to collect the Stardust, which is the base material of the popular cosmetic product, Della. The ladies in a queue threaten me so I had to ask the mercenary guild. You can extract a small amount of Stardust from Queen Rainiers in the Icarus. Please bring me 20 units of Stardust. (Party Possible)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20040
data.value: Thank you. You saved me from the execution ground. Second task is to get me the rare jewel Witch Queens in Aida carry on them. It's so beautiful as to captivate Witch Queens with such brilliance. Naturally, it's extremely expensive in the market. (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20041
data.value: So you want me to take the With Queen's jewel.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20042
data.value: Ok, I will head for Aida at once. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20043
data.value: Give me some time to prepare. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20044
data.value: Better grab a chance than to regret it. Well, come back later if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20045
data.value: Enter into Aida 2 and you will find Witch Queens. They always carry 'Kalt Stone' on themselves so eliminate them and take the jewel from them. Bring me 10 Kalt Stones. (Party Possible)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20046
data.value: Request from the Gens Steward; Location: Gens Duprian- Lorencia, Gens Banert- Noria; Task: Talk to the Gens Steward; Reward: Random, Purple Box; Note: If you haven't joined the Gens yet, choose one and join now to proceed.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20047
data.value: How have you been? On behalf of the master of our clan, I thank you for answering the call of the clan. I personally hate to let the wandering mercenaries do this job, so I requested to send someone of the clan. I hope this didn't offend you. (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20048

data.value: Not at all. It's only natural to work for the clan. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20051
data.value: I didn't mean to pester you. But as the clan gets stronger, so do you. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20052
data.value: Thank you. Recently things get in the way of the clan's business. Especially things in Vulcanus are the worst. We did some investigation and our people got killed by the assassins. Please go to Vulcanus and eliminate 20 Bloody Slayers and 10 Vicious Bloody Slayers.

data.value: May the glory be with you�� Good job. We found an evidence of the enemy clan from the investigation. We need to attack them in revenge immediately. Will you take this job? (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20060
data.value: Hi, I'm Priestess Beina, protector of this Underwater Temple. The sealed stone got stronger thanks to your effort, but Kundun's army is also getting stronger now. We investigated the sealed stone and found that Kundun's army absorbs its energy while Etramu's soul is taking a rest. Please help us and confine the energy of insanity within the sealed stone. (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20061
data.value: A hero is only human in the end, the energy of insanity��

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20062

data.value: According to our investigation, Necrons and Death Centurions absorb the energy of insanity while the sealed stone is taking rest. Please get rid of 30 Necrons and 20 Death Centurions to keep the energy of insanity from spreading. I'll prepare a reward when you finish this job. (Party Possible)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20066
data.value: Good job. The energy of insanity is safely contained since Necrons and Death Centurions have been eliminated. But the portion they already absorbed has been transferred to Kundun so we need to directly attack him. Can you help us? (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20073
data.value: Ah, you came at last. The task is to get me some equipment for the war supplies. There's no business more profitable than the war supplies delivery. It's not like the good old days, but enough for a stable income. Especially Tantalos's Armor and Burnt Murderer's Club are expensive ones. (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.value: Would you bring me Tantalos's Armor first? I will reward you fairly when you come back with 20 suits of armor from Tantalos in Tarkan 2.

data.value: Request from mercenary guild; Location: Devias mercenary guild; Task: Talk to Mercenary Guild Manager Tercia; Reward: Random, Red Box, Purple box; Note: The elders of the guild are real old fossils..

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20099
data.value: What can I help you? Ah�� you came for the request from us. Do you know Gaion? He was actually the sworn brother of the first mercenary guild master but our elders want to get rid of him since he's sort of an icon of treason. I don't understand their concern because he can never leave Varka. (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20100
data.value: ������... What's behind this story?

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20101
data.value: I want to hear more. (Accept)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20102
data.value: I don't know how this story can help me. (Refuse)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20103
data.value: Well, you may not want to learn more about him, but a mission is still a mission. I'll tell you more if you come back. (The quest has been cancelled.)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20104
data.value: Dural, the first master of the guild was a legendary commander who led us to a great victory against Kundun's army. He had to seclude himself from the world since Gaion's rebellion and the order of exterminating 5 major clans. The newly formed mercenary guild severed whatever relations with Gaion, but 5 major clans still want the mercenary guild to get rid of Gaion.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20105
data.value: ���� That's what happened.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20106
data.value: It wouldn't be easy to attack Gaion hiding in Varka. You'd better eliminate Raymond and Erkanne first to weaken his power. Without these two Gaion will not be as invincible. Go to Varka, kill Raymond and Erkanne and come back to me to get the reward from the guild.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20107
data.value: Welcome back. Now all you need to do is eliminating Gaion in Varka. Are you ready? (Lv. 350 - 400)

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20109

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20112
data.value: Go to Varka and eliminate Advisor Jerind and Gaion Kharein. When you finish the job and come back to me, I'll give you the reward from the guild. Also, you can get the refund without the Lv. 1 Request Completion Certificate when you complete this task.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20113
data.value: Have you cleared today's request? Show me Lv. 1 Request Completion Certificate then.

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20115

data.name: LegacyQuestWord_20116
data.value: Today's request is closed. Come back same time tomorrow and I will give you a new request. Thank you.
